title: 💰 Motorcycle Fines, Demerits & Penalties Matrix
summary:
• Basic Violations (NT$300–$1,000): Helmet unfastened / not worn (NT$500); Cargo exceeding shoulders/handlebars (NT$300–600); Handheld mobile phone while riding (NT$1,000 flat).
• Turns & Signals (NT$600–$5,400): Failure to make required two-stage left turn (兩段式左轉) or riding in no-moto inner lane (NT$600–1,200 + 1 demerit point); Running red light (NT$1,800–5,400 + 3 points).
• Severe Violations (NT$6,000–$36,000): Unlicensed riding (NT$6,000–24,000); Speeding ≥40 km/h over limit (NT$6,000–36,000 + 6 months plate suspension + 6 months license suspension).
• Alcohol & DUI (NT$15,000–$90,000): 1st motorcycle DUI offense (NT$15,000–90,000 + 1 to 2-year license suspension + motorcycle impounded). 2nd DUI within 10 years = NT$90,000 flat + 3-year License Revocation + Public disclosure of name and photo.
• Breathalyzer Refusal: Flat fine of NT$180,000 + Immediate License Revocation (3-year ban) + Motorcycle impounded.
key_numbers: NT$500: Flat fine for failing to wear approved helmet or chin strap unfastened
NT$1,000: Handheld phone while riding motorcycle
NT$600 – 1,200: Failure to make 2-stage left turn / Riding in car lane
NT$1,800 – 5,400: Running a red light (+ 3 demerit points)
NT$90,000: 2nd offense motorcycle DUI within 10 years
NT$180,000: Refusal of breathalyzer test (1st refusal)

title: 📦 Motorcycle Dimensions, Cargo Limits & Classifications
summary:
• Motorcycle Cargo Dimensions & Weight Limits:
  - Height: Must not exceed rider's SHOULDERS (max 1.5m for light moto, 2.5m for heavy moto).
  - Width: Must not extend more than 10 CM beyond handlebar ends on either side.
  - Length: Must not extend more than 50 CM past the rear axle.
  - Maximum Cargo Weight:
    * Small Light Motorcycle (<50cc / Green Plate): Maximum 30 kg (50 kg total).
    * Ordinary Heavy Motorcycle (50–249cc / White Plate): Maximum 60 kg (80 kg total).
    * Large Heavy Motorcycle (250cc+ / Yellow or Red Plate): Maximum 90 kg.
• Passengers & Child Seating:
  - Only 1 passenger permitted on rear seat for regular and heavy motorcycles. Prohibiting passengers on single-seat mopeds, and STRICTLY PROHIBITING children standing on front footrest.
key_numbers: Shoulders: Height limit for cargo on motorcycles
10 cm: Maximum lateral overhang beyond handlebar ends
50 cm: Maximum rearward overhang past rear axle
60 kg: Cargo weight limit for ordinary heavy motorcycles (50–249cc)
0.8 mm: Minimum tire tread depth for motorcycles

fines_table.violation: Carrying cargo exceeding legal motorcycle dimensions
fines_table.why: Oversized cargo disrupts center of gravity and two-wheeled stability.

fines_table.violation: Carrying children standing on the front footrest
fines_table.why: Children have zero restraint and are thrown off in sudden stops.
